observations.statement: Storage owns durable runtime, HITL, command, receipt, and projection record families; replayable runtime coordination and audit use event-sourced seglog authority, while file-based material is an export or inspection mirror.

Attempt and permission snapshots must preserve the named tool payload fields plus result, requested/effective provider, model, account and persona identities, permission, account-switch, pressure, quality-report, and GUI-disclosure data.

Command records are graph-local and command-family-specific, restore page, tab, run, thread, and inspector context without implying editing or opening, and normalize wrapper payloads into the enumerated route-target and subject fields.
Blocked episodes use blocked_sequence within run_id and node_id scope, and projectors preserve that identity in blocked projections, recovery references, and Ledger routes.

Projection states are current, refreshing, stale, degraded, and unavailable; record-backed fallback slices remain available during unhealthy states, while sensitive actions require canonical revalidation.
Review findings, concerns, blocked episodes, and annotations remain distinct record families; concern lifecycle meanings and lineage preservation are separately stated.

Non-trivial exports use a canonical manifest containing export family, scope, canonical identities, included records and artifacts, artifact path rules, backing-object status, trust state, and re-query or revalidation disclosure; CSV and JSON are serializations rather than authority.

Receipts bridge attempts, usage, evidence, artifacts, and UI surfaces but do not own lifecycle truth; cross-project or historical pivots require project_id, actor references, created_at_utc, and usage_event_ref.

Runtime storage defines a canonical object-family bundle and a shared identity/reference envelope, while attempt and execution-session records add orchestration, role, provider, account, permission, and operational-target identity.

Worktree and lane identities and lifecycle/history states are first-class; storage owns persisted state and joins, while operational cleanup and UI behavior belong to the named worktree owner document.
Project registry and shell UI state are separated from coordination EventRecord truth and from project summary and attention projections.

Action-capable record views must expose currentness, generation match, supersession, and actionability before mutation controls; blocked actions additionally use allowed_action_ids and canonical runtime identity.
Historical semantics separate time, replacement, and validity status; historical, archived, removed, and stale_historical have distinct meanings, and concern history remains lineage-preserving.
Records and artifacts remain distinct: records are structured canonical objects, artifacts are linked renderable outputs, and lineage references resolve through indexes to an openable target.
Account pressure episodes are durable records with an enumerated field set and statuses active, cooled_down, resolved, and invalidated.

GUI-facing storage behavior distinguishes summary/action right-side inspectors from full-record views, routes degraded concern deep links to exact records, and gates mutation controls on displayed record status.

candidate_findings.summary: Canonical owner sections are structurally empty or untraceable.
candidate_findings.obligation: The document declares owner sections for the shared envelope, export taxonomy, concern lifecycle, routing, projection trust, startup rehydration, artifact indexes, lane cleanup, and special recovery register.
candidate_findings.gap: The headings appear without section-specific normative bodies or acceptance mappings before the next headings, leaving builders to infer which later rules satisfy each declared owner section.

candidate_findings.summary: Snapshot persistence and GUI disclosure lack an executable schema.
candidate_findings.obligation: Attempt and permission snapshots must preserve the enumerated tool, result, requested/effective identity, permission, pressure, quality-report, and GUI-disclosure data.
candidate_findings.gap: The capsule does not define field types, requiredness, nullability, cardinality, versioning, validation, requested/effective invariants, or the exact GUI disclosure payload and rendering states.

candidate_findings.summary: Command-family routing requiredness is undefined.
candidate_findings.obligation: Each named command family must persist enough data to restore route context and normalize raw payloads into canonical routing fields.
candidate_findings.gap: Enough is not made testable: there is no per-command required/optional field matrix, normalized target schema, invalid-payload behavior, focus_behavior vocabulary, or deterministic rule for resolving competing record, artifact, attempt, lane, and worktree identifiers.

candidate_findings.summary: Artifact index eligibility is left to builder judgment.
candidate_findings.obligation: Artifact indexes must treat optional attempt_id and node_id as first-class indexed references where relevant.
candidate_findings.gap: The relevance predicate, indexing cardinality, uniqueness, missing-reference behavior, backfill behavior, and required query capabilities are not defined.

candidate_findings.summary: Project summary rollup behavior is not deterministic.
candidate_findings.obligation: project_summary.v1 must roll up active-run state, dominant concern or blocked owner, highest-severity attention, pressure, and health/config integrity without replacing attention records.
candidate_findings.gap: Dominance, severity ordering, tie-breaking, active-item filtering, pressure aggregation, health composition, and freshness windows are unspecified, allowing materially different summaries from the same records.

candidate_findings.summary: The canonical export manifest has fields but no contract shape.
candidate_findings.obligation: Non-trivial exports must carry one canonical manifest and disclose canonical identities, contents, backing-object status, trust state, and revalidation behavior.
candidate_findings.gap: No manifest version, field types, requiredness by export family, ordering, integrity checks, error behavior, or criterion separating lightweight views from non-trivial bundles is specified.

candidate_findings.summary: Projection trust and action gating explicitly defer consequential decisions.
candidate_findings.obligation: Storage must decide when stale or degraded projections are inspectable, when canonical revalidation is required, when mutation or export authority is withheld, and which fallback slices remain usable.
candidate_findings.gap: There is no state-by-operation decision table, definition of sensitive action or strong notification claim, selected-slice inventory, revalidation freshness bound, failure behavior, or atomic recheck rule.

candidate_findings.summary: Dashboard layout persistence variants have no precedence or migration contract.
candidate_findings.obligation: App-default, project override, and project-scoped persistence must not silently reuse one dashboard_layout:v1 contract for every surface.
candidate_findings.gap: The capsule does not define separate keys or shapes, inheritance and precedence, reset behavior, surface applicability, schema migration, or conflict resolution among the three persistence layers.

candidate_findings.summary: Temporary concern projection migration has no cutover protocol.
candidate_findings.obligation: Node concern rendering may use finding_refs only until a minimal non-remediation node_concerns projection exists.
candidate_findings.gap: There is no completion criterion, projection schema, dual-read or dual-write rule, backfill process, version boundary, or behavior when both representations disagree.

candidate_findings.summary: The staged/generated artifact subject-open contract is asserted but not defined.
candidate_findings.obligation: Storage must provide one canonical subject-open contract spanning first-class staged or generated artifacts, later filesystem materialization, and backing-document assignment.
candidate_findings.gap: No subject schema, lifecycle states, identity-preservation rules, materialization transition, document-assignment cardinality, failure recovery, or route-resolution behavior is provided.

candidate_findings.summary: Recovery records lack exact behavior and state transitions.
candidate_findings.obligation: Recovery records must cover recovery kind, restore and reconciliation modes, target scope, trigger, preconditions, result, resulting linkage, and affected concerns.
candidate_findings.gap: The capsule provides labels but no recovery-kind enum, required-field matrix, precondition evaluation rules, success/partial/failure result schema, idempotency, retry, rollback, concurrency, or resulting attempt/run linkage rules.

candidate_findings.summary: Operational identity is not sufficiently specified for audit-safe execution.
candidate_findings.obligation: Side-effectful or externally scoped runtime records must carry requested and effective operational references, kind, selection reason, partial capability, target authority, and surface scope, distinct from provider account identity.
candidate_findings.gap: The block has no concrete field names or types beyond its prose labels, operational-kind vocabulary, requested/effective precedence, authority representation, scope grammar, partial-capability semantics, or mismatch/failure handling.

candidate_findings.summary: Attention escalation thresholds are undefined.
candidate_findings.obligation: Minor advisory concerns remain local or in-app, while seam-blocking concerns with no progress may escalate to blocked surfaces and system notification according to severity and elapsed time.
candidate_findings.gap: Severity ordering, no-progress calculation, elapsed-time clock origin, threshold values, quiet-window interaction, escalation/de-escalation transitions, deduplication, and notification retry behavior are not specified.

candidate_findings.summary: Receipt and usage/provider join precedence is not defined.
candidate_findings.obligation: Downstream surfaces must coherently join usage_event_ref, usage_event_id, provider_attempt_ref, receipts, usage, artifacts, and object identity without substituting one identifier for another.
candidate_findings.gap: There is no authoritative join algorithm, precedence rule, cardinality, missing or conflicting identifier behavior, cross-project validation, or precise test for when a surface may pivot historically or across projects.

candidate_findings.summary: The canonical record-family bundle lacks per-family contracts.
candidate_findings.obligation: Runtime storage must persist the canonical family bundle and shared identifiers, lineage references, actor fields, record kind, and record ID.
candidate_findings.gap: The capsule does not assign required and optional fields per record_kind, define primary-key scope, uniqueness, referential integrity, versioning, tombstone rules, or whether singular and array spellings can coexist.

candidate_findings.summary: Attempt identity aliases and precedence remain ambiguous.
candidate_findings.obligation: Attempt and execution-session records must carry orchestration, role, provider/account, permission, and operational identity and expose requested/effective values.
candidate_findings.gap: The list mixes spellings and apparent aliases such as actor-role and actor_role, feature_seam and feature_seam_id, and work_package and work_package_id without canonicalization rules; allowed_roles and disallowed_roles conflict handling, requiredness, snapshot timing, and requested/effective resolution precedence are absent.

candidate_findings.summary: Lane lifecycle and Source Control row states have no deterministic mapping.
candidate_findings.obligation: Lane/worktree lifecycle states must remain separately queryable while Source Control exposes live, dirty, conflict, orphaned, recovering, retained, archived, and removed rows.
candidate_findings.gap: The capsule does not state whether the two vocabularies are aliases or orthogonal dimensions, nor map active to live/dirty/conflict, suspect to orphaned, restoring to recovering, or cleanup_eligible and historical to Source Control presentation and actions.

candidate_findings.summary: Coordination mirror checkpoint semantics are undefined.
candidate_findings.obligation: Project state may persist optional coordination mirror-export metadata such as the last exported sequence or checkpoint while coordination EventRecords remain runtime authority.
candidate_findings.gap: No checkpoint format, monotonicity, source stream, crash consistency, replay reconciliation, staleness behavior, or rule preventing mirror metadata from being mistaken for authority is defined.

candidate_findings.summary: Concern lifecycle transition legality is ambiguous.
candidate_findings.obligation: Concern lifecycle uses active, acknowledged, resolved, and dismissed, with defined meanings, rationale requirements, lineage-changing transitions, and compensating undo records.
candidate_findings.gap: The arrow notation implies a linear active-to-acknowledged-to-resolved-to-dismissed sequence, while the meanings and direct actions imply dismissal can be an alternative action; allowed transitions, reopening conditions, resolution_kind values, rationale schema, authorization, and evidence thresholds are not defined.

candidate_findings.summary: Mutation gating lacks an atomic authorization contract.
candidate_findings.obligation: Action-capable views must display currentness, generation match, supersession, and actionability before mutation controls, and blocked actions must use allowed_action_ids.
candidate_findings.gap: The sources of those flags, generation comparison algorithm, refresh timing, allowed-action identifier registry, authorization intersection, stale-click handling, and required server-side revalidation at execution time are unspecified.

candidate_findings.summary: Account pressure lifecycle invariants are missing.
candidate_findings.obligation: Account pressure episodes persist the enumerated fields and retain active, cooled_down, resolved, and invalidated as queryable statuses.
candidate_findings.gap: No allowed transition graph, cooled-down versus resolved criterion, invalidation authority, timestamp invariants, episode deduplication, overlapping-episode rule, confidence scale, or projected_remaining unit is defined.

candidate_findings.summary: Historical status dimensions are semantic prose without a storage schema.
candidate_findings.obligation: Time, replacement, and validity status must remain separate, with distinct historical, archived, removed, stale_historical, superseded, revoked, and reopened meanings.
candidate_findings.gap: Field names, enums, legal combinations, transition rules, precedence in filtering and routing, resumability checks, and rules for exposing later remediation or graph-generation supersession are not specified.

candidate_findings.summary: Artifact route resolution delegates the strongest-target choice.
candidate_findings.obligation: Runtime lineage references must resolve through indexes to the strongest openable artifact, document/report, detail record, generated buffer, or related surface target.
candidate_findings.gap: Strongest has no deterministic priority order, capability test, fallback chain, ambiguity handling, missing-target behavior, or rule governing when file-open is inappropriate, creating consequential cross-surface routing discretion.

candidate_findings.summary: Migration aliases lack a governed translation lifecycle.
candidate_findings.obligation: Legacy tier, event, mode, route, and glossary spellings remain searchable or ingestible only as subordinate compatibility aliases and must not become parallel canon.
candidate_findings.gap: There is no alias registry, version range, producer acceptance deadline, canonical translation table, collision behavior, warning or error policy, telemetry, or removal criterion.

candidate_findings.summary: Special runtime-governance state is assigned an owner but not specified.
candidate_findings.obligation: Startup recovery, counter ceilings and backoff, DAE jail lifecycle, attention escalation, account-switch invalidation, and wizard blocked escalation must resolve through policy, run-mode gates, and storage-owned recovery records with authoritative owner references.
candidate_findings.gap: The capsule supplies no counters, ceiling units, backoff algorithm, jail states and transitions, recovery linkage, invalidation triggers, wizard escalation transitions, or record-field definitions for these obligations.

candidate_findings.summary: Large-run queryability has no measurable capability contract.
candidate_findings.obligation: Active and historical concerns, governance and recovery records, retained lanes, and cleanup-eligible lanes/worktrees must remain separately queryable.
candidate_findings.gap: No required indexes, query keys, pagination, ordering, retention bounds, consistency behavior, or density/performance acceptance thresholds are stated.

candidate_findings.summary: Project attention rollups lack exact aggregation rules.
candidate_findings.obligation: Project cards and badges show the highest-severity active item plus a count, while the attention center preserves each object-linked active item.
candidate_findings.gap: The severity order, tie-breaker, active-item predicate, count inclusion rules, merged or acknowledged concern treatment, blocked-episode relationship, and behavior under stale projections are unspecified.

candidate_findings.summary: The governance-record template does not define family-specific requirements.
candidate_findings.obligation: Concern, review, promotion, corroboration, graph-patch, and recovery records share an envelope with lineage, status, actor, timing, evidence, artifact, source, and contract linkage.
candidate_findings.gap: The capsule does not define the envelope schema or the required status vocabulary, evidence obligations, lineage constraints, and additional mandatory fields for each record family, so producers can emit incompatible records while nominally using the template.

explicit_non_gaps.statement: Primary replay authority is explicitly event-sourced seglog; file-based and loose JSON material cannot be competing runtime canon.
The blocked_projection identity key is explicitly run_id, node_id, and blocked_sequence.
Projection freshness and projection health are explicitly separate concepts, and the five projection states are enumerated.
Review findings, concerns, blocked episodes, and annotations are explicitly distinct rather than interchangeable record types.
Receipt records are explicitly cross-surface pivots and not replacements for attempt, usage, evidence, blocked, artifact, wizard, or lane/worktree lifecycle truth.
Requested/effective provider-account identity and operational target identity are explicitly distinct audit dimensions.
Historical, archived, removed, retained, and cleanup-eligible states are explicitly prohibited from collapsing into one cleanup state.
Action-capable record views have an explicit minimum disclosure set before mutation controls: currentness, generation match, superseded status, and actionable status.
Account pressure episode fields and the four status labels are explicitly enumerated, including preservation of cooled_down as separately queryable.
Records and artifacts are explicitly separate, and summaries or views must resolve back to exact records rather than replacing them.
Legacy tier and PuppetMasterEvent names are explicitly migration inputs or compatibility transport, not canonical execution identity or primary operational state.
Project registry, project shell state, coordination runtime truth, project summary, and project attention are explicitly separated ownership domains.

unknowns.statement: It is unknown whether a concrete shared governance/runtime envelope schema exists outside this capsule.
unknowns.reason: The core names the envelope and later lists shared fields, but capsule restrictions prohibit inspecting referenced contracts or other owner documents.

unknowns.statement: It is unknown whether exact GUI disclosure copy, visibility conditions, and surface behavior are specified in the referenced GUI and command documents.
unknowns.reason: The snapshot rule delegates needed GUI disclosure to named consumers without including that disclosure contract in this capsule.

unknowns.statement: It is unknown whether worktree lifecycle transitions, archive/remove behavior, and Source Control UI rules are fully defined by the named operational owner.
unknowns.reason: The capsule assigns those behaviors to WorktreeGitImprovement.md, which is outside the permitted source excerpt.

unknowns.statement: It is unknown whether provider, account, execution-role, permission, and requested/effective precedence is deterministic in the referenced shared runtime contracts.
unknowns.reason: The core says precedence is resolved elsewhere and records only the resolved inputs; those contracts cannot be inspected under this assignment.

unknowns.statement: It is unknown whether automated acceptance evidence validates the prose-only storage obligations identified here.
unknowns.reason: The core requires verification and routing coverage before matrix or gate consumers claim authority but does not enumerate executable checks or receipts for these individual obligations.

unknowns.statement: It is unknown whether a canonical alias translation registry exists outside this capsule.
unknowns.reason: The core enumerates many compatibility spellings and their subordinate status but does not identify a concrete registry or translation artifact within the permitted excerpt.
